notes.subject: mwathi
notes.rationale: מלך wa ngwatanĩro-inĩ ya ũthamaki nĩ 'mwathi', ti 'mũthamaki' wa gĩkundi kĩa andũ

notes.subject: mũingi wa hinya
notes.rationale: גבור nĩ 'mũri wa hinya, mũthaki wa mbaara' — ũhoro nĩ mũthuri ũrĩ na hinya mũingi

notes.subject: עזוז
notes.rationale: Hapax ĩrĩa ĩtagwo 'mwenetagũĩ hinya' no ĩtaũrwo 'mbũtũ cia hinya' nĩgũo 'collectively an army' kiugĩte

notes.subject: עזוז
notes.rationale: Kiugo kĩu gĩkuuma Tanakh-inĩ gĩkũndĩ gĩkũngĩ mũno hakĩhĩ

notes.subject: גבור...גבור
notes.rationale: Kiugo gĩkĩronjorerio igũrũ rĩrĩa kĩrĩkũ mwanya-inĩ wa kũrathima Yahwe ũthĩnjagĩa — mũhiano wa kũgathaithagia ndũire

translation: Nĩ ũĩ ndani mwathi ũcio wa ũthingu? Nĩ Yahwe, mwenetagũĩ hinya na mũingi wa hinya; Yahwe, mũingi wa hinya thĩinĩ wa ya ukĩrĩka-inĩ.
